videos.title: How Do Fossils Form?: Crash Course Geology #18
videos.author: CrashCourse
videos.description:
Everybody dies, but few fossilize. In this episode of Crash Course Geology, we’ll learn how fossils form and why they’re so rare. Although very few living things ever become fossils, those that /do/ help us understand Earth’s history and how life came to be as it is today.
